---
title: "Acquisition Systems"
---

This section provides guides for loading data from specific acquisition systems and generic data formats.

| System / format | Description |
|---|---|
| [Intan](intan.qmd) | `amplifier.dat` / `digitalin.dat` |
| [Open Ephys](openephys.qmd) | Open Ephys acquisition folders |
| [LabJack](labjack.qmd) | LabJack log files |
| [Doric](doric.qmd) | Doric Neuroscience Studio exports |
| [Spike2 (CED)](spike2.qmd) | `.smr` / `.smrx` via SonPy |
| [SpikeSorter](spikesorter.qmd) | SpikeSorter CSV output |
| [Generic HDF5](generic_hdf5.qmd) | HDF5-based recordings |
| [Wavesurfer HDF5](wavesurfer_hdf5.qmd) | Wavesurfer `.h5` bit-packed TTL scans |
| [Generic binary](generic_binary.qmd) | Raw binary layouts |
| [Image stacks](image_stacks.qmd) | Multi-frame imaging folders |
